purpose: Diagnose data, model capacity, evaluation design, and recursive drift without replacing the frozen model.
descriptive_eda: Training data only. Exposed validation/test metrics and range/phase shifts are explicitly postmortem error analysis, not fresh validation.

sanity_check.selection: First 64 training rows sorted by date and treatment.
sanity_check.score: Same small training batch only; intentional memorization to test feature/label wiring. Never score this diagnostic model on held-out data.

uncertainty.kind: Moving date-block bootstrap of existing held-out paired absolute-error differences, averaged over treatments per date.
uncertainty.limits: Conditional uncertainty within one exposed site/sequence, not independent-season or recommendation uncertainty. Blocks must not cross missing dates.

checks: training station/NASA rain association without choosing a date shift
promotion: None; no production model, preprocessing, split, selection, or payload changes.
